newsitem.title: USA: Gilbert to buy TEC Cellular for $14 mln.
newsitem.headline: Gilbert to buy TEC Cellular for $14 mln.

text.p: Gilbert Associates Inc said Monday it has signed a letter of intent with TEC Cellular Inc to acquire TEC for $14 million.
TEC, said the company, would become a division of SAFCO Technologies Inc, Gilbert's primary company serving the global wireless communications market, said the companies.
The acquisition is expected to be consummated on or before April 15, and is subject to execution of definitive documentation and customary closing conditions.
If the acquisition is completed, Gilbert will pay TEC shareholders in cash, plus certain other incentives for performance and long-term growth.

The transaction is expected to be slightly accretive to Gilbert's earnings per share in 1997, after consideration of a possible write-off of in-process research and development. The size of that write-off has not yet been determined, a statement issued by the companies said.
